editorial:
Imagine spending thirteen years in prison for a crime you did to protect your best friend, only to get out and have that same friend drag you right back into trouble. That is exactly what happens to AJ. He just wants to open a small business and keep his head down, but the universe has other plans. The vibe here is a gritty street story about loyalty and the struggle to change your life when your past refuses to let go. You will really feel for AJ as he tries to do the right thing while being pulled back into a world of violence by the person he trusts most.

The acting is solid and keeps the story moving quickly without feeling rushed. While some of the plot twists are a bit predictable, the action scenes are punchy and keep you on the edge of your seat. It is a great pick if you love stories about friendship and betrayal. It is definitely a movie that looks great in high definition.
endingExplained: In the end, AJ has to face the truth about Jack's loyalty. After a tense showdown, it is revealed that Jack was not as innocent as he claimed to be. AJ finally breaks the cycle of crime by turning Jack in to the police, choosing his own freedom over a toxic friendship. He manages to clear his name and finally starts his business, finding the peace he wanted since the start.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves crime dramas about redemption and betrayal.
